import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int modpow(int a, int e) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = a;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) != 0) ret = (ret * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        Map<Integer, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        List<Integer> m3 = new ArrayList<>();
        int[] comp = new int[20];

        // Generate all 6-bit numbers with exactly 3 bits set
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 6); i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == 3) {
                m3.add(i);
                map.put(i, m3.size() - 1);
            }
        }

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] pr = new int[6][6];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                pr[i][j] = (int) ((long) val * modpow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (i == j) pr[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }
        n = 6;

        int sizeSub = 1 << 18;
        int[][] sub = new int[2][sizeSub];
        int[] mas = new int[sizeSub];
        int[][] p = new int[2][1 << 20];

        // Precompute comp array
        for (int i = 0; i < m3.size(); i++) {
            int val = m3.get(i);
            int other = map.get(val ^ 63);
            comp[i] = other;
        }

        // For each mask
        for (int mask = 0; mask < sizeSub; mask++) {
            sub[0][mask] = 1;
            sub[1][mask] = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                    int bitIndex = (i * 3) + j;
                    if (((mask >> bitIndex) & 1) != 0) {
                        sub[0][mask] = (int) ((long) sub[0][mask] * pr[i][j] % MOD);
                        sub[1][mask] = (int) ((long) sub[1][mask] * pr[i][3 + j] % MOD);
                    } else {
                        int od = 1 - pr[i][j];
                        if (od < 0) od += MOD;
                        sub[0][mask] = (int) ((long) sub[0][mask] * od % MOD);
                        od = 1 - pr[i][3 + j];
                        if (od < 0) od += MOD;
                        sub[1][mask] = (int) ((long) sub[1][mask] * od % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Compute mas array
        for (int mask = 0; mask < sizeSub; mask++) {
            int ind = 0;
            for (int m : m3) {
                List<Integer> guys = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                    if (((m & (1 << i)) != 0)) {
                        guys.add(i);
                    }
                }
                boolean bad = false;
                for (int xd = 0; xd < (1 << 3); xd++) {
                    int ms = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                        if (((xd >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                            ms |= ((mask >> (guys.get(i) * 3)) & 7);
                        }
                    }
                    if (Integer.bitCount(xd) > Integer.bitCount(ms)) {
                        bad = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!bad) {
                    mas[mask] += (1 << ind);
                }
                ind++;
            }
        }

        // Initialize p arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeSub; i++) {
            p[0][mas[i]] = (p[0][mas[i]] + sub[0][i]) % MOD;
            p[1][comp[mas[i]]] = (p[1][comp[mas[i]]] + sub[1][i]) % MOD;
        }

        // Fast subset sum for p[1]
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); mask++) {
                if (((mask & (1 << i)) != 0)) {
                    p[1][mask] = (p[1][mask] + p[1][mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        int fullMask = (1 << 20) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            long val1 = p[0][i];
            long val2 = p[1][i ^ fullMask];
            ans = (ans + val1 * val2) % MOD;
        }
        ans = (MOD - ans) % MOD; // 1 - ans mod
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
